    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const container = document.querySelector("#scene");
    const loading = document.querySelector("#loading");
    const resetButton = document.querySelector("#reset");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene, and camera
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      alpha: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);

    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "A bamboo-framed box kite flying in the sky"
    );
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xc5dce5, 15, 34);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const controls = {
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.35, 0),
      spherical: new THREE.Spherical(10.5, 1.25, 0.68)
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      camera.position.setFromSpherical(controls.spherical).add(controls.target);
      camera.lookAt(controls.target);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xeaf8ff, 0x77664d, 2.1);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffefd2, 3.2);
    sunLight.position.set(-7, 11, 8);
    sunLight.castShadow = true;
    sunLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sunLight.shadow.camera.left = -8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.right = 8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.top = 8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.far = 30;
    sunLight.shadow.bias = -0.0003;
    scene.add(sunLight);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural textures
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createPaperTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 256;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#f2e6c4";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 256;
        const y = Math.random() * 256;
        const alpha = 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.045;
        const length = 2 + Math.random() * 18;

        ctx.strokeStyle = Math.random() > 0.5
          ? `rgba(91, 67, 31, ${alpha})`
          : `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha * 1.5})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        ctx.lineTo(x + length, y + Math.random() * 1.5);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function createBambooTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 128;
      canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 128, 0);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#b87a37");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.2, "#e0ad63");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.55, "#d7a357");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.8, "#e5ba73");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#b97a36");
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 128;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(83, 45, 16, ${0.025 + Math.random() * 0.08})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          x + Math.random() * 10 - 5,
          150,
          x + Math.random() * 12 - 6,
          350,
          x + Math.random() * 8 - 4,
          512
        );
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      for (const y of [72, 215, 360, 475]) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(75, 39, 13, 0.38)";
        ctx.fillRect(0, y - 4, 128, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 224, 160, 0.25)";
        ctx.fillRect(2, y - 2, 124, 2);
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    const paperTexture = createPaperTexture();
    const bambooTexture = createBambooTexture();

    const paperMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xfff4d3,
      map: paperTexture,
      roughness: 0.92,
      metalness: 0,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const bambooMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      map: bambooTexture,
      roughness: 0.52,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const jointMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x704728,
      roughness: 0.76
    });

    const stringMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x3b3027,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const redPaperMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc95b3e,
      roughness: 0.88,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const borderMaterial = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x9b4c35
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials and geometry helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function addRod(parent, a, b, radius = 0.09, material = bambooMaterial, segments = 10) {
      const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
      const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
      const direction = end.clone().sub(start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        length,
        segments,
        1,
        false
      );

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addJoint(parent, position, radius = 0.105) {
      const joint = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 12, 8),
        jointMaterial
      );
      joint.position.set(...position);
      joint.castShadow = true;
      parent.add(joint);
      return joint;
    }

    function addPanelBorder(parent, width, height) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
        new THREE.Vector3(-width / 2, -height / 2, 0.012),
        new THREE.Vector3(width / 2, -height / 2, 0.012),
        new THREE.Vector3(width / 2, height / 2, 0.012),
        new THREE.Vector3(-width / 2, height / 2, 0.012)
      ]);

      const line = new THREE.Line(geometry, borderMaterial);
      parent.add(line);
    }

    function createPanelGeometry(width, height, bulge = 0.12) {
      const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(width, height, 8, 8);
      const positions = geometry.attributes.position;

      for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
        const x = positions.getX(i);
        const y = positions.getY(i);
        const radial = Math.min(
          1,
          Math.pow(x / (width / 2), 2) +
          Math.pow(y / (height / 2), 2)
        );

        positions.setZ(i, bulge * (1 - radial));
      }

      positions.needsUpdate = true;
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      return geometry;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // The kite
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const kite = new THREE.Group();
    kite.position.set(0, 4.15, 0);
    scene.add(kite);

    const halfSize = 2.4;
    const frontZ = 0.46;
    const backZ = -0.46;
    const frameZ = 0.58;

    // Four corner uprights.
    for (const x of [-halfSize, halfSize]) {
      for (const y of [-halfSize, halfSize]) {
        addRod(kite, [x, y, backZ], [x, y, frameZ], 0.095);
        addJoint(kite, [x, y, 0], 0.11);
      }
    }

    // Front and back square frames.
    for (const z of [backZ, frameZ]) {
